question: Which mechanisms of writing, holding and switching does the self-sustained oscillator with one-quantum gain and two-quantum loss (maser, phonon laser) carry, and with which laws?

provenance.source: Lee & Sadeghpour, PRL 111, 234101 (2013); Walter, Nunnenkamp & Bruder, PRL 112, 094102 (2014)
provenance.kind: authored quantum carrier (mean field + vacuum noise of the loss channel, truncated Wigner)

name: self-sustained oscillator with one-quantum gain and two-quantum loss (maser, phonon laser)
closure: gain g1 D[a†] and two-quantum loss g2 D[a^2]; noise of the gain approximated as additive, D ~ g1/8
observable: phase of the oscillation relative to the injected tone
assumptions: mean field of the quantum van der Pol oscillator
frame of the injected tone, detuning Delta
